title: PaymentRequiresAction
description: Interim reply to payments.request-payment: the PaymentIntent is in requires_action (3-D Secure). The customer must complete it in the storefront with stripe.handleNextAction(clientSecret). No money is taken yet; payments later publishes payments.payment-succeeded or payments.payment-failed (from the Stripe webhook, or failed with reason timeout at expiresAt). A re-sent request-payment re-publishes this event while the action is pending. Keyed by paymentId.

clientSecret.description: The PaymentIntent's client_secret. Only the paying customer may see it: checkout shows it on that customer's checkout and nowhere else.

expiresAt.description: When payments cancels the PaymentIntent if the customer has not finished the action (10 minutes after it was created).
